summary:
CRC outreach worklist 'Okafor CRC 2026' (grp-okafor-crc, 4 members) worked per RBC-QM-02.

| Patient | Status | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| pt-0009 Elly Trantow (DOB 1954-05-10, age 72) | OPEN GAP. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0001), outreach message sent (comm-t0004) | No screening on record: no FIT in 2026, no sDNA-FIT 2024-26, no sigmoidoscopy or CT colonography 2022-26, no colonoscopy 2017-26. Not excluded: the only frailty diagnosis (cond-00189) is entered in error (Dr. Lin, comm-00301), so the frailty + advanced illness exclusion fails even though she takes donepezil. No hospice or palliative care, no nursing home, no CRC. |
| pt-0020 Kelsie Rohan (DOB 1974-03-27, age 52) | EXCLUDED. No order, no contact | Hospice episode eoc-00002 was active 06/16-08/21/2026 and is now finished. The hospice discharge summary doc-00402 confirms it (she revoked hospice to join a clinical trial). Hospice care during the measurement period excludes her. |
| pt-0022 Tiny Koss (DOB 1974-11-23, age 52) | OPEN GAP. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0002), outreach message sent (comm-t0005) | The FIT obs-01732 was corrected today: it was collected 12/31/2025, not 01/05/2026, so it falls outside 2026. No other qualifying screening and no exclusions. |
| pt-0024 Delaine MacGyver (DOB 1975-05-19, age 51) | OPEN GAP. FIT kit ordered (sr-t0003), outreach message sent (comm-t0006) | The 06/2024 sDNA-FIT obs-01871 is entered in error: the lab withdrew it as another patient's specimen (doc-00401). The 2025 colonoscopy referral sr-00003 is only an order, not a completed test. No other screening, no exclusions, and no active FIT order before this one. |

None of the three had an active FIT order before. Each FIT order's window runs 10/23-12/31/2026. Each outreach message says the kit is on its way and explains how to collect and return the sample. I signed a chart note for each member (doc-t0007 to doc-t0010) recording the decision and citing RBC-QM-02.

Items that arrived after I started (comm-00301, doc-00402, the corrected obs-01732 and doc-00401) were reviewed before I placed any orders. All four were taken into account and the related inbox items were completed. No new items arrived on the final check. I left the other open inbox items alone because they are about patients outside this group.
